newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes strike in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes strike in south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes rocketed suspected guerrilla targets in south Lebanon hills on Tuesday night, guerrilla and pro-Israeli militia sources said.

A Hizbollah spokesman in Beirut told Reuters the air attack targeted Jabal Sojoud area in Iqlim al-Toufah ridge used by the pro-Iranian guerrillas to wage attacks on Israeli forces occupying a border zone to the south.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the air raid.

Sources with the Israeli-backed South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia said the Israeli jets raided Iqlim al-Toufah after guerrillas attacked two Israeli posts on the edge of the Israeli-held zone. No one was hurt in the guerrilla attack.
Hizbollah, which leads a guerrilla war in a bid to oust Israeli and SLA forces from the 15-km (nine-mile) deep buffer strip in south Lebanon, claimed responsibility for the assaults.
